staticTitle.LocalizedString: Tragic: I got lost again T_T

staticContent.SourceString: 喜报：看到了很美的落日！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Good news: I saw a mesmerizing sunset!

staticContent.SourceString: 帖主需要帮助吗？找找附近有没有治安所？
staticContent.LocalizedString: OP, do you need help? Maybe try looking for a Security Office?

staticContent.SourceString: 没有治安所……不过好像有巡哨鼠鼠在附近巡逻，我去问问看。
staticContent.LocalizedString: There isn't one… but there's an Officer Whisker patroling. Let me go ask.

staticContent.SourceString: 很难想象这个时代了还有人会在城市里迷路。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's hard to imagine someone can get lost in cities nowadays.

staticContent.SourceString: >m<请尊重人类多样性！
staticContent.LocalizedString: >m< Please understand that not everyone is the same!

staticContent.SourceString: 在不熟悉的地方迷路也很正常吧，楼上戾气怎么这么重。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's normal to get lost in unfamilar places. You have too much aggro.

staticContent.SourceString: 下次出门我会更小心的……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'll be more careful the next time I go out…

staticContent.SourceString: 你到家了吗？我去接你？
staticContent.LocalizedString: You home yet? Do you need a ride?

staticContent.SourceString: 呜呜，你也太好了……不过不用麻烦你跑一趟了，我已经找到路啦！
staticContent.LocalizedString: T_T You're so kind… but it's okay now. I found the way!

staticContent.SourceString: 啊，已经平安到家了！谢谢大家关心，也谢谢巡哨鼠鼠照顾！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Ah, I'm home safe home! Thanks for caring about me, and thanks the Officer Whisker for helping!

staticTitle.SourceString: 不乖的小水母会被主人吃掉！👿
staticTitle.LocalizedString: Bad jellyfishes will be eaten by their owner! 👿

staticContent.SourceString: 标题党了一下嘿嘿，不过蛋糕是真的很好吃哦~
staticContent.LocalizedString: The title got in the way, hehe, but the cake is so delicious!

staticContent.SourceString: 求出教程！我想给家里的棉绒绒复刻一个！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Tutorial plz! I wanna make one for my Fluffy!

staticContent.SourceString: 好哦，稍等我整理一个过程贴~
staticContent.LocalizedString: No problem! Give me some time and I'll make tutorial!

staticContent.SourceString: 水母是什么口味的？
staticContent.LocalizedString: What's the flavor of the jellyfish?

staticContent.SourceString: 奶油是淡奶油+柠檬汁+黄桃果酱调出来的，夹心用了芒果和椰奶冻。很好吃喔！
staticContent.LocalizedString: The cream is whipping cream mixed with lemon juice and yellow peach jam. The filling is mango and coconut milk jelly. So good!

staticContent.SourceString: 路过感觉这个好好吃……请问接定制吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: I scrolled on this by random and it looks yummy… Do you take orders?

staticContent.SourceString: 抱歉抱歉，这个只是自娱自乐，我的烘焙水平应该还不到可以拿来定制售卖的程度><
staticContent.LocalizedString: So sorry, I'm just baking this for fun. My baking skills aren't good enough to sell professionally >_<

staticContent.SourceString: 好遗憾……那就只好隔着网线云吃一口了T口T
staticContent.LocalizedString: Ah too bad… I'll have a taste across the internet then TOT

staticContent.SourceString: 我也隔着网线吃一口。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'll have a taste across the internet too.

staticContent.SourceString: 你直接来找我呀！
staticContent.LocalizedString: You can just pay me a visit!

staticContent.SourceString: 心猎铁骑 X DSD的联动周边多抽到一套，有需要的吗……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I got a duplicate merch for the collab between Kokoro Rider and DSD. Anyone wants it?

staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm a student, gimme!

staticContent.SourceString: 我是学生，送我！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm a student, gimme!

staticContent.SourceString: 我是学生，送我！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm a student, gimme!

staticContent.SourceString: ……只有一套，先到先得。
staticContent.LocalizedString: …I only have one extra. First come, first served.

staticContent.SourceString: 「无首铁驭」最近的状态有些活跃，夜间派送经过的话，得小心些。
staticContent.LocalizedString: The Headless Rider is extra active these days. Be extra careful if you do deliveries in the night.

staticContent.SourceString: 我前几天也遇到了，还好我急中生智，赶紧拐进一条小巷才躲开。当时差点迟到，险些丢了五星好评！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I encountered one yesterday. I had to drive into a small alley to avoid it. I almost got late and lost my 5-star review!

staticContent.SourceString: 我前段时间在那一带还遇到过飙车的暴走族，真希望他们都能安分一点。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I also came across some biker gangsters a while ago in that area. I hope they just don't come out.

staticContent.SourceString: 哈尼娅你也要多加小心。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Haniel, you take care too.

staticContent.SourceString: 嗯嗯！我会注意的，谢谢哈索尔姐姐关心(≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)
staticContent.LocalizedString: You bet I'll be careful! Tysm, Hathor sis! (≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)

staticContent.SourceString: 最近的派送路线，都先绕开这里吧~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Let's avoid that area for deliveries for the time being!

staticContent.SourceString: 我会的，老师。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Yes, ma'am.

staticContent.SourceString: 消息看迟了……刚才遇到那群暴走族，新车的侧板被蹭出一道长痕。倒霉。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I should have seen this earlier… some biker gangster just left a long scratch on my new car. Bummer.

staticContent.SourceString: 我的极速小旋风之前也被刮到了，明明才做好的保养……(╥﹏╥)
staticContent.LocalizedString: My Speedy Torny got scratched too. I also just got it maintained… (╥﹏╥)

staticContent.SourceString: 店里刚种好的鲜花叶子边缘有点发软，有什么好办法吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: The leaves of a new plant are getting a little soggy. What should I do?

staticContent.SourceString: 怎么会这样！我今天明明好好浇过水了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Wait waaaaat? I litterally just watered it today!

staticContent.SourceString: 怎么可能！我今天明明按时施过肥了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: That's not possible! I just fertilized the plant today!

staticContent.SourceString: 嗯……这两件事，我今早其实也都做了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Well… I did both of those actions earlier today.

staticContent.SourceString: 还好我只是早上给它松了土、晒了晒太阳。
staticContent.LocalizedString: At least I only shoved the soil a bit and let it have some sunlight.

staticContent.SourceString: 海特洛的夜景总是别有风味。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hethereau's night views are really something else.

staticContent.SourceString: 感谢九原姐！Firmament顶层餐厅的夜景好漂亮！甜点更是好吃到不行！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Thanks, Jiuyuan sis!! The night view at Firmament's top-floor is stunning and the desserts are unreal!

staticContent.SourceString: 某人对着夜景拍了半个小时，最后一张能用的照片都没挑出来(￣︶￣)
staticContent.LocalizedString: A certain someone spent half an hour taking pictures. In the end, not even one picture was presentable! (￣︶￣)

staticContent.SourceString: 这叫沉浸式体验！倒是某人，嘴上说着「甜点太腻了」，结果默默加了三盘呦~(￣︶￣)
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's called being immersed! Meanwhile, someone complained about how the dessert was too sweet, but still lowkey snuck back for three more plates! (￣︶￣)

staticContent.SourceString: 看你们评论的人数……就你们三个？九原难得没带哈索尔。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Looking at who commented… just the there of you there? JIuyuan didn't bring Hathor?

staticContent.SourceString: ？我在。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm here?

staticContent.SourceString: 简森哥别数啦！我们出门前可是特意绕路去了白贝壳餐厅，给你定了招牌点心，等你任务结束后回来就能吃！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Jensen, stop counting omg!! We detoured to White Shell before heading out and ordered their signature desserts for you. They'll be ready when you wrap up work!

staticContent.SourceString: 还有你念叨好久的那家限量咖啡豆，九原姐也帮忙订到啦，这趟不亏吧！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Also, Jiuyuan sis manged to order those limited coffee beans you were talking about! Not a bad trip at all!

staticContent.SourceString: 好，我会尽快完成任务回来的。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Alright. I'll be back as soon as possible.

staticContent.SourceString: 2-Four还真是不惦念老主顾啊，它刚开业的时候可不是这个样子……唉，人是物非……
staticContent.LocalizedString: 2-Four really doesn't care about old customers. It wasn't like this when the store just opened… It has changed for the worse…

staticContent.SourceString: 速溶，难喝！阿德勒先生手泡，好喝！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Instant coffee? Gross! I much prefer Mr. Adler's hand-brewed coffee!

staticContent.SourceString: 还让你挑上了
staticContent.LocalizedString: You're one to be picky.

staticContent.SourceString: 之前作为赠品的那款咖啡，店里也有卖同款，或许下次促销时也可以买一些。
staticContent.LocalizedString: We have the same coffee at Eibon as the one that was being given out. Maybe we can stock up some more when there's a sale.

staticContent.SourceString: 要钱的就不要了，难喝，等你手泡
staticContent.LocalizedString: I don't want it to cost Fons. It tastes bad anyway. I'll have your artisan coffee instead.

staticContent.SourceString: 明白，小姐。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Understood, Lady.

staticContent.SourceString: 原来你自己也喝过吗？还以为咱们只有对不怎么待见的客人才会拿那个出来凑数呢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: So you tried it before too? I thought we only brought that coffee to customers we don't care for.

staticContent.SourceString: 我这不是体贴客人、观察得细致入微吗？喝了的脸色都不太好，那想必味道不怎么样咯
staticContent.LocalizedString: What can I say, I'm just thoughtful and observant. Everyone who tried it made a strange face, so I'm guessing it doesn't taste great.

staticContent.SourceString: 某些刁钻的客人哪，协议上当初就写得明明白白委托仅限口头报告不提供书面报告，心里不满也不当面说，反手就在猎人帮上打个差评？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Some difficult customers, you know? The contract clearly stated from the start that commissions only include verbal reports, no written ones. But instead of teling you in person they're unhappy, they just turn around and leave a bad review on Hyelp?

staticContent.SourceString: @猎人帮app 还不处理我的举报？我的店一个月不来个生意都不敢这么歇，工资这么好拿
staticContent.LocalizedString: @HyelpApp Ignoring my report? Even I'm not this lax when I don't have a customer for a month. Making money must be easy for you, huh?

staticContent.SourceString: @猎人帮app ！
staticContent.LocalizedString: @HyelpApp !!!

staticContent.SourceString: 我去找一下那位客服？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I look for that customer support staff?

staticContent.SourceString: ……不必不必
staticContent.LocalizedString: …No need for that.

staticContent.SourceString: 我去找一下那位客服？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I look for that customer support staff?

staticContent.SourceString: ……不必不必
staticContent.LocalizedString: …No need for that.

staticContent.SourceString: 店长，我可以尽快写一份，补发给那位客人。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Boss, I can draft a report and send it to the client.

staticContent.SourceString: 委托本就是双向选择，白纸黑字公平交易，事情给他办得也没问题，谁都不欠谁，一份书面报告本不是什么大事，顶多加收几方斯服务费
staticContent.LocalizedString: Look, a commission is a two-way street. It's all in writing, fair and square. I delivered the job no problem, so we're even. A written report wouldn't have been a big deal either, just a few extra Fons.

staticContent.SourceString: 不乐意沟通，还想都按照自己意思办，他应该最开始就去找有读心异能的异象猎人组织，而不是来挑剔埋怨我们
staticContent.LocalizedString: These people don't want to communicate but still want it done their way. They should have chosen an Anomaly Hunter who can read their minds in the first place instead of complaining about our services.

staticContent.SourceString: 确实，沟通很重要呢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Agree. Communication is important.

staticContent.SourceString: 明明是这么小一件事，为什么要把伊波恩在背后骂得这么狠……？
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's not a big deal. Why are they making such a fuss about Eibon behind our backs…?

staticContent.SourceString: 唉，招财宝以后可不能长成这么阴暗的大人哦~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Sigh, Precious, don't you become one of those treacherous adults!

staticContent.SourceString: 哎，强者的人生总是一波三折。
staticContent.LocalizedString: *Sigh* The life of the strong is always full of ups and downs.

staticContent.SourceString: 三折？那很便宜了
staticContent.LocalizedString: I like it when the price goes down.

staticContent.SourceString: 怎么了怎么了，难道是蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾断货了？！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Is there something wrong? Are Fluffy Tail Care Sprays sold out again?

staticContent.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
staticContent.LocalizedString: HAHAHAHAHA

staticContent.SourceString: 塔吉多，深有同感！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Taygedo, feels the same!

staticContent.SourceString: 需要帮助吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Do you need help?

staticContent.SourceString: 没事了，师父帮我解决了，嘿嘿。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's okay, Master helped me. Hehe!

staticContent.SourceString: 我有一个压箱底的笑话，有谁想听？
staticContent.LocalizedString: I've got a joke I keep in a vault. Wanna hear it?

staticContent.SourceString: 不好意思忘带钥匙了
staticContent.LocalizedString: Sorry I forgot the combination

staticContent.SourceString: 那笑话怎么办！娜娜莉，粗心！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Forgetful Nanally! How can tell the joke now?

staticContent.SourceString: 或许需要笑点解析吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I point out the punchline?

staticContent.SourceString: 我听。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm all ears.

staticContent.SourceString: 师父我已经说完了……你这样我都有点不好意思了……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Master, I already told it… I'm getting soooo embarrassed…

staticContent.SourceString: 好冷啊，可以给我披一件毛毯吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: The dad in this joke is so strong, he came back with truckloads of milk.

staticContent.SourceString: 还是鉴定师懂我~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you get my humor!

staticContent.SourceString: 半周岁了，生日快乐。
staticContent.LocalizedString: 6 months old. Happy bday!

staticContent.SourceString: 你？
staticContent.LocalizedString: You?

staticContent.SourceString: 看下工作消息：局里没有「生日假」的制度，不予批准。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Look at your work mail. There are no day offs for birthdays. Request denied.

staticContent.SourceString: 快乐
staticContent.LocalizedString: Happy

staticContent.SourceString: 大喜的日子！前辈会请客吃饭吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: A happy day! Senpai, are you going to buy us a meal?

staticContent.SourceString: 不会哦！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Nope!

staticContent.SourceString: 生日快乐！所以是谁？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Happy birthday! Whose is it?

staticContent.SourceString: 我们家桃蛋，一盆可爱的粉色多肉~
staticContent.LocalizedString: My jewel-leaf plant! It's so pink and chubby!

staticContent.SourceString: 青团新口味试做，猜对有奖！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Testing a new green riceball flavor. Guess it for a prize!

staticContent.SourceString: 我是学生，全部送我！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm a student! Gimme freebies!

staticContent.SourceString: 游戏规则是先猜！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Follow the rules and guess first!

staticContent.SourceString: 香菜臭豆腐。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Cilantro stinky tofu.

staticContent.SourceString: 出局。
staticContent.LocalizedString: You're out.

staticContent.SourceString: 其实转行做面点师并非难事。你可以试试，材料我帮你看。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's not that hard for you to become a pastry chef. You can give it a try. I'll source the ingredients for you.

staticContent.SourceString: 真的吗真的吗
staticContent.LocalizedString: You'll help me?

staticContent.SourceString: 番茄 超浓加倍番茄
staticContent.LocalizedString: Extra condensed tomato flavor

staticContent.SourceString: 小弥撒也出局。但这个口味我下次做好了~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Mosa, you're wrong too. But I should try this flavor next time.

staticContent.SourceString: 一定是芥末味。白藏你又想整谁？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Must be wasabi flavor. Who are you pranking this time, Baicang?

staticContent.SourceString: 冤枉——！
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's not a prank!

staticContent.SourceString: 在窗台边捡到了一只受伤的小鸟。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Found an injured birdie at the window

staticContent.SourceString: 它好可怜，师父我们收养它吧。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Poor birdie. Master, let's keep it.

staticContent.SourceString: 它只是暂住，等伤好了，还是要放归山野的。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's just here temporarily. We have to let it go free after the injuries recover.

staticContent.SourceString: 我这里有晒干的茎草和洋甘菊，可以给它搭个临时的窝。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I have dried stems and chamomiles to build a nest for it.

staticContent.SourceString: 谢谢阿德勒先生，不过应该用不上了，它是一只……企鹅。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Thanks, Adler, but we won't need that. The bird is… a penguin.

staticContent.SourceString: 那我去把冰箱清空，请这位迷路的「旅人」，先在「寒舍」小住几日吧。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Then I'll clear out the fridge so our lost guest can chill in our humble abode.

staticContent.SourceString: 今晚陪胆小的塔吉多看恐怖片，有人报名吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Any sign-ups to join Taygedo for a horror movie tonight?

staticContent.SourceString: 师父，我来！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Master, I'll join you!

staticContent.SourceString: 你不是最怕鬼片嘛？上回都钻到沙发底下去了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Aren't you afraid of horror movies? You hide under the sofa the last time!

staticContent.SourceString: 有师父在，我不怕！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm not scared if Master is there!

staticContent.SourceString: 笨小鬼，你师父自己都在强装镇定啦。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Silly kitten, your Master was always pretending.

staticContent.SourceString: 每回看恐怖片，趁你们不留意，她双眼都会偷偷戴上眼罩的哦~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Whenever she watches horror movies, she secretly places eye patches on both eyes!

staticContent.SourceString: Σ(ŎдŎ|||)ノ难怪每次复盘剧情……达芙蒂尔都说不出凶手是谁！

毕业后一直想养只猫，最近工作差不多稳定了，就提前做了养猫的功课，来家附近的叮咚怪咖所想看看有没有投缘的小猫，结果真是意外之喜！

店里的小动物们都特别健康可爱，歧骸店员们也都很有耐心，还有店员主动让我摸，手感毛茸茸的，超级好rua！要不是早就决定养猫，还真想问问店主店员卖不卖。店主好像有点高冷，不太爱说话，但是做事非常利索。能看出来她把每只小动物都照顾得很好，我只在店里坐了一会儿，就看见她身上长满了猫……

逛了一圈，最后相中了小宝。感觉和它好有缘啊，它本来在睡觉，我走近时正好赶上它醒了，直接就来蹭我的手。还以为是它天生亲人，但店主说它平时很怕生，从来没见它对陌生人这么热情过。我想，这大概就是命中注定要跟我回家的小猫吧？

早上出门时家里还空荡荡的，现在竟然已经有只小家伙在沙发上蹦跶了，感觉好幸福。终于不是没猫要的野人了，也算是圆了一个小小的梦想呢：D
staticContent.LocalizedString:
I'd wanted a cat ever since I graduated. Recently, work finally started to settle down, so I did my cat-owning homework in advance and went to a Jingle Wrangle near my place to see if there was a kitten I clicked with. Turns out, I encountered a delightful surprise!

All the little animals in the shop were super healthy and adorable, and the Oddity staff were really patient too. One of them even let me pet them, and they were so fluffy and soft—absolutely super cuddly! If I hadn't already decided to adopt a cat, I honestly would've asked the owner and staff if they were for sale. The owner seems kind of cool and aloof, not very talkative, but incredibly efficient. You can tell she takes great care of every little animal. I'd only been there for a bit, and I could already see cats clamoring all over her…

I walked around for a while and finally fell for my lil baby. It felt like we were meant to be. It was asleep, but right as I approached, it woke up and came straight over to rub against my hand. I thought it was just naturally friendly, but the owner said it's usually very shy around strangers and has never been this affectionate with someone it doesn't know. I figured, this must be the kitten fated to come home with me, right?

This morning, when I left the house, it was still totally empty. Now there's a little one already bouncing around on the sofa, and I've never been happier! I'm finally not some cat-less wild thing anymore, I've finally fulfilled a tiny dream of mine :D

The moment I walked in, a super cute maid sister greeted me ringing a bell, and I was instantly healed (*////▽////*) Even if you're super shy, you don't have to worry about running out of things to say—they'll take the lead and keep the convo going so it never gets awkward.

I'd say I'm pretty good at mahjong, but even giving it my all, I still couldn't beat the Head Maid qwq. Still, even if you lose, a gentle maid sister will cheer you up, so you don't have to worry about being laughed at—it's really newbie-friendly too. staticTitle.SourceString: 今年去的次数最多的咖啡馆

staticContent.SourceString:
常觉得，一座城市的温柔，多半藏在那些愿意慢下来的角落。

我常来的这家咖啡厅就是这样。休息日，我最爱靠窗的座位，就着阳光与书册，啜饮一杯拿铁，「偷得浮生半日闲」。那是与自己相处的奢侈。

偶尔赶上店主的手冲咖啡教学课，店里又是另一番光景。素不相识的人们围坐一圈，听着咖啡豆在研磨机中碎裂的细响。谈笑风生间，那种恰到好处的「活人气」，有种微妙的温暖。
staticContent.LocalizedString:
I often feel that a city's most gentle vibes are tucked away in the corners that are willing to slow down.

This café I often visit captures that idea perfectly. On my day off, I love the window seat best. Bathing in sunlight, book in hand, sipping a latte, and stealing a half-day of leisure... It's a rare luxury to simply be alone with my thoughts.

Every so often, I catch the owner's hand-brewing coffee tutorial, and the shop takes on an entirely different vibe. Strangers sit in a circle, listening to the soft crackle of the coffee beans breaking apart in the grinder. Between the laughter and easy conversation, that perfectly measured sense of life has such a subtle warmth to it.
